situation.estimate: Late-stage (about 8 years old, 201-500 employees per LinkedIn) construction-intelligence vertical SaaS, Israel R&D with a heavy North America/UK go-to-market. The $130M round (Sep 2026, $297M total, 'cusp of unicorn' per CEO in press) funds expansion across North America and EMEA, deeper lifecycle coverage and a Buildots Field workforce product (from the Genda acquisition, Oct 2025). The GTM is shifting from project selling to enterprise selling (stated in the GTM AI Engineer JD), with ABM, paid media, field marketing and a data-center vertical push. Marketing has repositioned around 'construction intelligence' and a research hub (Buildots Intelligence Lab, 15 benchmark pages), while blog cadence dropped from ~41 posts in 2024 to 12 in 2026.
